finding.title: Ambiguous frontend CLI JSON bypassed reviewed-input integrity
finding.severity: P2 functional/operator input integrity; no remote theft demonstrated
finding.current_counterexample: CLI json.loads accepted duplicate amount/chain/policy keys by selecting the last occurrence, while HTTP/RPC/durable state already rejected ambiguity. The activation request file was read after Projection construction.
finding.implementation: All three frontend CLIs strictly parse every required JSON file and require objects before constructing Projection/WorkerPool/listeners. Shared read_json adds keyword-only encoding=None; frontend explicitly retains UTF-8. Nested duplicates, nonfinite/overflow numbers and nonobjects reject through existing fixed CLI diagnostics.
finding.not_changed: HTTP handlers, typed schemas, finite numeric input validation, economics, contract ABI, public signing, network endpoints, installed services and existing state/journals are unchanged.

before.test_fixture_note: Before/after assertions and fixture logic are identical. Only unused MagicMock import was removed from the new test between runs; this is disclosed rather than calling the full test file byte-identical.

after.positive_control: Valid UTF-8 object/finite1.25 preserve exact dictionaries through mocked downstream validators; no actual RPC/network/listener is created.

counts: Seven distinct final passing methods in this slice: four new CLI regressions plus three existing affected state compatibility controls. Invalid subcases and before/after attempts are not extra distinct methods.
limitations: No broad unchanged suite or test requiring real services was run.
Downstream schemas, RPC and listener creation are mocked only at their constructor boundary in the CLI fixtures.
Indexer CLI has separate ops-owned verification; do not double count shared tests.
No public network, signing, state migration, deployment, service restart or website rollout.
Shared source pins require reviewed matching deployment of future service artifacts; local source changes are not operating qualification.
